remarks: One of New Canaan's distinguished landmark residences, this extraordinary home is gracefully sited on 2.6 acres of sweeping lawns and mature trees along coveted West Road, just under a mile from the village.A meticulous expansion and renovation have reimagined this home for modern living, while honoring the timeless elegance and architectural integrity of the original home. Sun-filled, graciously scaled interiors unfold through a series of beautifully proportioned rooms, where french doors throughout open seamlessly to an expansive bluestone terraces and the park-like grounds beyond.The residence offers five bedrooms and four newly renovated full baths, including a light-filled primary suite with private sitting room and walk-in closet.The ground floor features a stunning Great Room, a front to back living room, an elegant dining room and a beautifully refreshed chef's kitchen that opens to a light-filled breakfast room with its own private stone terrace. An expansive family room, framed by walls of windows, captures sweeping views of the landscape. Completing the first floor plan is a new bright and sunny laundry room, two beautifully appointed half baths and a thoughtfully designed mudroom leading to a brand-new second-floor home gym.The third floor boats a private home office and another bedroom suite with full bath. A truly rare and incomparable offering, combining vintage charm, modern luxury, and an exceptional West Road location; ready for the most discerning buyer.
